exposure: Surgical site infection type (superficial incisional, deep incisional, organ/space)
outcome: Prevalence of surgical site infection (SSI) after cesarean section (CSEC)
Antimicrobial resistance of pathogens causing SSI
cohort: 2,326 women who underwent a cesarean section in 11 regional women's hospitals in Ukraine
finding: The study found a high rate of SSI (14.7%) after CSEC, with the majority of infections (70.5%) detected post-discharge and a significant proportion of causing pathogens demonstrating antibiotic resistance.
